environment.description: Ktor service deployed on bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No reverse proxy adding security headers. Service binds directly to port 8080, NLB forwards TCP traffic transparently. Authentication is handled by a shared API gateway that sets X-User-Id header but performs no object-level authorization. No CSP headers are injected at any layer. Browser clients render widget HTML responses directly.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
config.auth_model: API gateway sets X-User-Id, no RBAC enforcement
config.network: public subnet, direct client access via NLB
